desc: Virtual or imagined, once something is truly felt, it stops being unreal. Everything a person touches in a lifetime is just a drop in the vast river of time. Still, I hope this song can carry you into a sweet delusion.
desc2: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: There is a soul, even within a shell of steel.
name: Angel in the Shell

1.desc: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>. When the equipper is an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color> character, and comes on-field or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG they trigger increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.
1.name: Energetic Strike
